title: Requirements, ownership and approvals
owners: M1; acknowledgments from M2-M6 and mentor
dependencies: Original PRDs/master specification; actual team handles and backups
acceptance: Record real identities and sources; map FR/AC to owner, ticket, test and evidence; obtain actual affected-owner and mentor decisions. Never fabricate signatures.
evidence: Source provenance and traceability; owner acknowledgments; approval records

title: Audit and freeze shared contracts
owners: M1 with all affected producers and consumers
acceptance: All examples and references validate, negative cases reject, interface ambiguities resolved by approved decision, consumer contract tests pass. Only then publish contracts-v1.0.0.
evidence: Validator output; consumer tests; signed decision; immutable contract tag

title: Locked shared development environment
owners: M1; module manifests supplied by M2-M6
dependencies: Selected uv/npm tooling; owner package manifests
contracts: Existing canonical schemas remain the validation source
acceptance: Locked setup and root commands work on Windows/Linux; missing owner handoffs fail explicitly; no teammate internals implemented by M1.
evidence: uv sync --locked; npm ci; contract/unit/quality results; fresh clone smoke

title: GitHub governance and CI
owners: M1; independent reviewer for M1 changes
paths: .github; root scanner settings; trusted approval tooling
dependencies: Repository feature eligibility; admin access; M1-03; actual owner handles
acceptance: PR-only main, independent current-head approval, passing required checks, cross-owner M1 plus owner approval. Windows/Linux contract CI; secret scanning; verify server-enforced settings.
evidence: Protection API readback; CI runs; approval-policy tests; documented limitations

title: First integrated mock workflow
owners: M1 integrates; M2 runner, M3 API/store/mock, M4 checker, M5 scenario, M6 UI
paths: M1 root integration tests and infra; owner modules changed only by their owners
dependencies: M2-M6 mock handoffs; approved development scenario and startup commands
contracts: FIXED; 202 QUEUED; ordered events; PENDING findings
acceptance: Fresh launch executes UI -> queued worker -> runner -> mock adapter -> mandatory checker -> stored evidence. Runtime responses validate. Fixture-only checks are not runtime evidence.
evidence: Commit and contract version; labeled MOCK trace; runtime smoke and browser test

title: Adaptive integration and reliability
paths: M1 integration tests; infra/compose.yaml; owner fixes in separate PRs
dependencies: M1-05; adaptive runner; usage accounting; cancellation/recovery hooks
contracts: Existing budgets, allowlists, state transitions and failure semantics
acceptance: Two observation-dependent adaptive traces; method parity; limits before calls; no state leakage or instruction execution; queued resume/running fail on restart; isolated batch failures; persistent local containers.
evidence: Owner tests plus runtime reliability suite; Compose launch; two adaptive traces

title: Review, retest and report integration
paths: M1 integration/browser harness and release evidence
dependencies: M1-06; actual review/retest/report routes; approved retest decision
contracts: Append-only reviews; confirmed-only retests; RetestView; ReportSummary
acceptance: Human fixture review is idempotent and preserves proposal; pending retest has null result; clone parity; exports and recomputed denominators correct; Arabic RTL and evidence navigation pass.
evidence: API smoke; browser tests; report recomputation; screenshots; feature-freeze checklist

title: Local evaluation and verified release
owners: M1 coordinates; M2/M3 model readiness; M4 human review; M5 experiments; M6 demo
paths: M1 release/runbook/evidence assembly; owner analyses remain owner-owned
dependencies: Original requirements; signed experiment protocol; local model/hardware approval; M1-07
contracts: 120 security runs proposed: 80 matrix + 40 repeats; separate scoring-repeatability ledger
acceptance: Freeze models/policies/splits/seeds before final runs; reproduce metrics from stored IDs; report failed/pending/inconclusive cases; second laptop and two rehearsals pass; only then approve and tag release.
evidence: Frozen manifest; run/review ledger; reproducible report; machine verification; actual approvals
